title: Cute looking cup but that’s about it
text: Cute looking cup but that’s about it. Cute looking cup.  That’s the only plus.  Does not keep ice from melting.  Way to expensive for just a cute outside.  It just is poor quality.  Don’t waste your money.  Suggestion, buy a better cup that actually keeps your drinks cold and decorate the outside yourself.

product_metadata.title: Not A Day Over Fabulous - 20 Oz Stainless Steel Insulated Tumbler, 20-Ounce, Glitter Mermaid
